# compare_harness fixtures

Synthetic / layout-only helpers for P3.9. **No disc images or real saves.**

| Path | Use |
|---|---|
| `../memcard/empty_slot.mcr` | Empty 128 KiB card for CLI dry-run / path checks |
| `pair.md.example` | Template for local `build/compare/<label>/pair.md` |

Owner gameplay saves stay outside git (e.g. under `runtime/us/memcard/`).
